title.bn: মিনি প্রজেক্ট: ফাইলে student record রাখা

summary.en: Build a bounded menu-driven record manager with add, list, search, update, delete and checked text persistence.
summary.bn: মেনু দিয়ে student record যোগ, দেখা, খোঁজা, বদলানো ও মুছে ফেলা শেখো; প্রতিটি পরিবর্তন ফাইলে রাখো।

notes: Local single-user exercise with fictional records; not a production student information system.
Text replacement uses checked rename on the documented Linux host; concurrent writers and crash durability are outside scope.

sections.title: Write a complete replacement before publishing it
Grow the design by changing one contract at a time
Review a whole operation from request to restart

examples.title: Add, search, update and delete fictional records
examples.explanationHtml: Start with an empty students.txt. Add two rolls, reject a duplicate, update roll 101, then delete roll 102. Each saved message follows a successful file replacement. Listing preserves insertion order and displays only active records.

examples.title: Load existing records and reject malformed menu requests
examples.explanationHtml: The starting file contains two valid records. Out-of-range marks and trailing junk are rejected before mutation. A missing roll is a normal search result, and the final list confirms that rejected requests did not change the loaded records.

practice.title: Extend the record manager with acceptance cases
practice.statementHtml: Use the complete manager as the reference implementation. Support A/L/S/U/D/Q exactly as shown, unique rolls 1–9999, marks 0–100 and capacity twenty. Begin with an empty supplied students.txt. Numeric tokens may be arbitrarily long within the line limit and must be rejected safely. Input lines longer than the buffer are drained and rejected. Persist successful mutations before printing saved.
hints: Keep parsing, searching, loading and saving separate.
Never substitute an unreadable existing database with an empty one.

practice.title: Design a safe name-field extension
practice.statementHtml: Plan adding student names with spaces while keeping records unambiguous and preserving rejected-operation behavior.
hints: A delimiter inside a field needs an escaping or length rule.
practice.answerHtml: Choose a bounded field length and an explicit encoding with escaping or lengths. Parse a complete record into temporary fields, reject missing or oversized names and duplicate rolls, then publish it only after validation. Update the persistence version and loader together. Test spaces, delimiters, empty names, the exact maximum and an overlong line. Do not append an unbounded %s field to the current numeric format.

quiz.explanation: Deletion shifts array positions, so an index is not a stable record identity.

quiz.prompt: Why reject a duplicate before append?
quiz.explanation: Search and update would otherwise have ambiguous targets.

quiz.prompt: What happens if loading an existing file fails?
options: Overwrite it with an empty database
quiz.explanation: A damaged or unreadable file must not silently become empty state.

quiz.prompt: What does deletion do to the bounded array?
options: Leave a live duplicate at the end
Shift later active records left and decrement count
quiz.explanation: Only the active prefix is saved.

options: To avoid checking the end pointer
To reject range errors and trailing junk before casting
quiz.explanation: The helper checks conversion and application bounds.

quiz.prompt: Why is the temporary-file replacement not a complete database transaction system?
options: Crash durability and concurrent writers need additional protocols
quiz.explanation: This local exercise documents its narrower host and ownership assumptions.

quiz.prompt: Which extension changes the storage contract?
options: Changing a local loop variable name
quiz.explanation: The format needs a stated field encoding and compatible loader.

keyPoints.en: Maintain unique rolls and a bounded active array prefix.
keyPoints.bn: Roll আলাদা রাখো এবং অ্যারেয়ের active অংশ capacity-এর মধ্যে রাখো।

keyPoints.en: Validate complete commands before changing records.
keyPoints.bn: Record বদলানোর আগেই পুরো command যাচাই করো।

keyPoints.en: Treat load failure as failure rather than an empty database.
keyPoints.bn: ফাইল পড়া ব্যর্থ হলে সেটিকে খালি database ধরে নিও না।

keyPoints.en: Announce saved only after all required file operations succeed.
keyPoints.bn: দরকারি সব file operation সফল হলেই saved বার্তা দেখাও।

keyPoints.en: Document local single-writer and persistence limits honestly.
keyPoints.bn: Local এক writer-এর শর্ত ও persistence-এর সীমা পরিষ্কার করে লেখো।

examQuestions.question: Design the add and update paths with unchanged-on-rejection behavior.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Parse the entire command, validate roll and mark, find the existing index and enforce uniqueness or existence. Only then change the active array. Save the result and report success only after persistence succeeds; stop on a save failure instead of continuing with uncertain disk state.

examQuestions.question: Explain why a temporary file is useful and what it does not guarantee.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Writing a new complete file avoids truncating the old file before the new content has been written. Check writes, close and rename. Replacement behavior is host-dependent for an existing destination; this exercise uses Linux. Crash durability, locking, hostile directory changes and concurrent writers need additional design.

examQuestions.question: Give a test plan for record identity and persistence.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Test add, duplicate add, existing/missing search, valid/invalid update, first/middle/last deletion, empty list and capacity. Restart after a successful save and verify the same active records reload. Corrupt the file and confirm startup fails without overwriting it. Include huge numeric tokens and an overlong command followed by a valid command.
